weekly.text: Upgrade 10 different Combat Arts at [[place:Smyrnos's Temple]] (about 400 shards) for Blacksmith
detail: Nobody here uses the class; it carries to later paths.
Spend every shard left before Part II: it sets them to 100 each chapter.

weekly.text: Sunday before the Bertrand battle: Unicorns' Bath on Catania

missables.text: Accept Anatolia's Paralogue by 10/14 and clear it by 10/17: its Electron Agitator is Fabio's
missables.lose: the [[item:Electron Agitator]], 20,000G, 150 Renown and Sha Lan's recruit

note.text: Exam Mikaela, Kiroc and Olympia as each hits Lv 35 and the ranks; Goliath usually follows in Ch 12
detail: Catch up anyone of Yang Jie, Fabio, Dietrich or Esmeralda who missed Lv 35 in Ch 10.
Dante, Simon and Jester wait for Part II Ch 1 to 2. Simon keeps fighting with gauntlets.

recruits.action: Right after Anatolia's Paralogue, answer Saramis, then Da Mina, then Grounded Ship
recruits.when: Once Renown 10 lands, after Queen of the Erased
detail: Filler, bench only: she brings a [[item:Salamander]].

prep.text: Dante first thing if you missed Renown 8 in Ch 10: the Bertrand battle ends this chapter
No new core recruits until Gaitz in Ch 12: keep his gifts and meals going

route.note: Renown 9, [[place:Nemea Cavern]]: its Heavy-Armor Manual goes to Esmeralda if Heavy is short of D
detail: Otherwise the manual goes to Goliath.

route.note: The day Renown 10 lands, [[place:Iapetus Cavern]]: unlocks Ranger, Jester's Part II class
detail: Read Archive θ on Fabio at once: Banshee Θ, Immobilize at 1-3.
Jester takes Ranger in Part II Ch 1 (Lv 35, Bow B, Sword B): the unlock is what you need now.
No Renown 10 this chapter? Oko moves to early Ch 12 (ends 11/27).

sub.note: Part of the 10/15 batch to finish before the Paralogues: Winged-Lion Key from Benetnasch
detail: Leads to Can't Stay Home (10/24).

sub.note: Listed for Ch 12, but due in this chapter: check the quest board
Listed for Ch 12, but due in this chapter: check the quest board
Aegina Crystal from [[place:Pyroxene Cave]], for the Citizen in City Streets
Kurdelind Ruins, for the Soldier at Credna's Temple
End of the A Letter of Some Gravity chain, which this plan skips

paralogue.note: Anatolia's, in City Streets: save every villager for a Spellshard and a Dew of Peace
detail: Cure the villagers' confusion first, then walk them east, then north, to the exit.
Leave the Pentkehydra; hit the oddly animated worms to stun it. Equip Kalla's Blessing (Avoid +50).
Screens: Dietrich, Esmeralda, Goliath. Heals: Yang Jie, Dante. Catania reaches far villagers.

paralogue.note: Cai's, from Cai in City Streets; the fight is on 10/22 in Dagsion
detail: Stop enemies reaching the exit and kill Centurio fast.
Deploy fast hitters: Dietrich, Jester, Catania, Io, Kiroc, plus a healer.

paralogue.note: Orchel's, from Orchel at Lower Temple Row; fight by 10/27. Healing Staff is Dante's
detail: The biggest map: two teams hit both switches on the same turn, so the Onager hurts the boss.
Pegasus Knight reinforcements come from the east: bring Kiroc and Jester.
The two chests only hold Pure Water.

explore.text: [[place:Nemea Cavern]] (Berenguela): Heavy-Armor Manual, [[item:Elixir]], Hammer, Sturdy Rucksack
[[place:Iapetus Cavern]] (Oko): Archive θ for Fabio, Black-Magic Manual for Olympia

tips.text: Trap squares cover most of the map (about 8 HP a step) until you engage Bertrand
detail: Send Catania (flying) or Dietrich up to him to switch them off; keep the rest on safe tiles in the south.
Check the artillery range with ZL before moving.

tips.text: Storm Awakening raises Bertrand's Avo for a turn: hit his allies, then let Dietrich duel him
Physic healers matter here: Yang Jie and Olympia
detail: Enemies are mostly physical, so armored units hold well.

exitExtra.text: Reach Renown 10 and beat Oko, or plan both for the first days of Ch 12
